wish: someone should make an app that annotates video by drawing on frames
spec:
Opens a local video and lets you draw in colour and add a caption on any frame; drawings reappear at their time during playback.
Pause, step frame by frame or type a time, draw with finger or mouse, mark frames, then save any annotated frame as a PNG.
Does not upload anything, does not render a new video file, and keeps marks per video file in this browser only.
notes: The template CSP allows only data: media, so the chosen video is read into memory as a data URL; very large files (several hundred MB) may be slow or fail on phones. Export is per-frame PNG, not a re-encoded video.
